source: Black Sword Hack - Ultimate Chaos Edition SRD, Dark pacts & other vileness, https://blackswordhack.github.io/6darkpact.html.
note: The six supernatural subsystems the design's Deferred roadmap item 2 names. Effect text stays a narrator ruling; the deterministic tables are the d6 Demon's Revenge and Torn Veil tables and the d100 sorcery spell draw. Transcribed from the retained SRD artifact docs/srd/dark-pacts.md; tests/test_subsystems.py holds an independent copy of the counts and d100 coverage, and data.py::_validate_subsystems refuses a gap in the d100 table or a missing backlash face.

demons.name: Abyss
demons.effect: Target becomes monstrous or disfigured for d6 hours; permanent on a 1.

demons.name: Envy
demons.effect: Target tries to seize a chosen object by force; the caster's own equipment becomes the target on a 1.

demons.name: Fear
demons.effect: The caster learns the target's deepest fear; the effect is mutual on a 1.

demons.name: Greed
demons.effect: Creates 4d6 fake coins lasting one hour; steals 4d6 of the caster's real coins on a 1.

demons.name: Hate
demons.effect: Target verbally abuses a chosen person for d6 minutes; the caster is abused on a 1.

demons.name: Isolation
demons.effect: Target is unseen and unheard for d6 hours; the caster cannot see the target on a 1.

demons.name: Gluttony
demons.effect: Target attacks randomly chosen people and consumes 2d6 HP worth; it wants to eat the caster on a 1.

demons.name: Nightmare
demons.effect: Target loses sleep, granting Advantage on the next day's tests against them; Disadvantage on a 1.

demons.name: Oblivion
demons.effect: Target is forgotten for d6 hours; the demon steals one Background on a 1, recoverable after a long rest.

demons.name: Ruin
demons.effect: Breaks equipment up to cart size; the caster's own gear breaks on a 1.

demons.name: Sloth
demons.effect: Target falls asleep; never wakes on a 1.

demons.name: Suspicion
demons.effect: Target suspects a chosen person; the caster becomes the suspected one on a 1.

demons.name: Wrath
demons.effect: Target goes berserk and attacks everyone; the caster is affected on a 1.

results.1: Cannot invoke this demon until the next sunrise.
results.3: The demon destroys an ally's weapon.
results.4: The demon takes payment in blood: lose d6 HP.
results.5: Broken pact: this demon can never be invoked again.
results.6: The demon manifests, inflicts 3d6 damage, and the pact breaks.

spirits.name: Ancestor spirit
spirits.effect: Grants Advantage on one attribute test, requiring an object belonging to the ancestor; gives Disadvantage instead on a 1.

spirits.name: Animal lord spirit
spirits.effect: Summons animal subjects to help or to cease attacking; the animals flee or attack on a 1.

spirits.name: Disease spirit
spirits.effect: Renders a target bedridden with a non-lethal disease until cured; the disease becomes contagious on a 1.

spirits.name: Fire spirit
spirits.effect: Manipulates an existing fire — double its size, shape it, move it — and inflicts d6 damage plus d6 ongoing; a rolled 20 burns the caster and a 1 extinguishes the fire.

spirits.name: Forest spirit
spirits.effect: Finds a way, food, water, or shelter in the wilderness, and summons plants granting Advantage against enemies for one turn; denies rest for two days on a 1.

spirits.name: Hunger spirit
spirits.effect: Drives a target to search for food or water until fed a full meal; affects the shaman too on a 1.

spirits.name: Pain spirit
spirits.effect: Prevents a target from acting for one Turn; afflicts the shaman at the same time on a 1.

spirits.name: River spirit
spirits.effect: Manipulates present water — double it, shape it, move it; the water disappears on a 1.

spirits.name: Wind spirit
spirits.effect: Extinguishes flames, dissipates fumes, or forces humanoids down; the effect reverses on a 1.

spirit_alliances.sacrifice: A shaman may sacrifice an alliance for one large effect (firestorm, hurricane, beast lord in the flesh); spirits of that type then shun the shaman and deny further alliances.
spirit_alliances.binding: Binding a new spirit always carries a price; the SRD provides a d20 price table. Adjudicated as a ruling.

results.1: Cannot cast spells until the next sunrise.
results.2: Energy ravages the body: lose d6 HP.
results.3: Arcane explosion: d6 damage to all Nearby.
results.4: The body pays the price: permanently lose 1 HP.
results.5: The mind shatters: permanently lose 1 INT.
results.6: A tentacled monstrosity appears and the caster is transported to another plane.

spells.name: Acid blood
spells.effect: Convert 3 HP to acid: d6 damage, or dissolves a small item.

spells.name: Animate mirror
spells.effect: A reflection attacks from a mirror for d6 damage.

spells.name: Blood mark
spells.effect: Mark a possession and always know its location; costs 1 HP permanently.

spells.name: Call the Id
spells.effect: Summon an invisible anger creature to remove an obstacle or deal 2d6 damage.

spells.name: Curse of the mute
spells.effect: Target cannot speak; permanent on a 1.

spells.name: Darkness
spells.effect: d6 targets are blinded for d6 minutes.

spells.name: Dead man's map
spells.effect: The blood of a corpse reveals the murderer's location.

spells.name: Deafening scream
spells.effect: Paralyze all who hear it; children and animals die.

spells.name: Demon's breath
spells.effect: Extinguish light sources and start a fire elsewhere.

spells.name: Dream guardian
spells.effect: Animate an object to guard the caster while sleeping.

spells.name: Dream message
spells.effect: Send a message through dreams with no line of sight.

spells.name: Fading memories
spells.effect: Target forgets d6 hours of interaction, or years on a 1.

spells.name: Feather crash
spells.effect: Survive a deadly fall; all equipment is destroyed.

spells.name: Feeding the fire
spells.effect: An existing flame bursts for d6 damage Nearby.

spells.name: Fireflies
spells.effect: Summon a torch-light swarm that disappears if violence occurs.

spells.name: Fleabag
spells.effect: Transform into a dog until sunset or sunrise, keeping HP and abilities, biting for unarmed damage.

spells.name: Ghost pains
spells.effect: The victim feels a loss and believes the caster can restore it.

spells.name: Gloomy lullaby
spells.effect: Target loses consciousness; permanent on a 1.

spells.name: Greedy hand
spells.effect: An item the target holds flies to the caster; it is destroyed on a casting roll of 1.

spells.name: Guiding rat
spells.effect: Underground, summon a rat to the nearest exit; costs d4 HP in blood.

spells.name: Hellhound
spells.effect: Transform a dog into a killer: Attack 11, Dodge 11, d6 damage, 10 HP; it dies after the fight.

spells.name: Impotent arrows
spells.effect: Projectiles do no damage next turn; allies' projectiles too on a 1.

spells.name: Inquisition
spells.effect: A restrained target endures pain and answers d4 questions; it dies if asked more.

spells.name: Iron ghost
spells.effect: Create an invisible weapon, invisible until used; costs d6 HP if it does not injure.

spells.name: Murmurs
spells.effect: Target hears voices revealing their darkest secrets.

spells.name: Never-ending music
spells.effect: Target hears a tune, granting Advantage on tests against them.

spells.name: Poisonous projectile
spells.effect: Make a projectile lethal; the victim dies in d6 minutes.

spells.name: Portal
spells.effect: Create a door to a known location; arrive naked, and followers roll d6, disappearing on a 6.

spells.name: Red trap
spells.effect: A blood pool costs 2 HP and stops movement.

spells.name: Rotten fumes
spells.effect: Advantage against Nearby targets for d6 minutes.

spells.name: Serpent bones
spells.effect: Boneless form for d6 minutes to escape bonds or squeeze through gaps.

spells.name: Sharing the pain
spells.effect: Transfer wound HP loss to a companion.

spells.name: Soundkiller
spells.effect: Muffle all nearby sounds for 2d6 minutes.

spells.name: Soul-eater
spells.effect: Chomp a target's soul: unconsciousness, or death on a 1.

spells.name: Spontaneous combustion
spells.effect: Target bursts into flames for d4 continuous damage; all burn on a 1.

spells.name: Steal life
spells.effect: Take d6 HP from a touched target, not exceeding the caster's maximum.

spells.name: Tongue thief
spells.effect: Speak six words through a target's mouth.

spells.name: Unnatural speed
spells.effect: Target moves a Far distance per turn; random equipment is destroyed on a 1.

spells.name: War drums
spells.effect: Target experiences war horrors; d6: 1–4 panic, 5–6 berserk.

spells.name: Wine of death
spells.effect: Drinkers seek fights and kill each other on a 1.

spells.name: Withering
spells.effect: Target has the strength and vitality of a 90-year-old for d6 hours.

ties.name: Barrow wisdom
ties.effect: Speak with the dead; a WIS test compels an answer, decreasing the Doom die.

ties.name: Cauldron of gold
ties.effect: A magic coin worth 100 returns after 1d8 dawns.

ties.name: Changeling knowledge
ties.effect: Advantage on tests in two chosen areas of expertise.

ties.name: Cold iron weapon
ties.effect: A legendary blade dealing +d6 damage against faerie.

ties.name: Doomed to greatness
ties.effect: Once per day, roll the Doom die with Advantage; recovery requires 1d3 long rests.

ties.name: Dwarf deceit
ties.effect: Advantage when lying or sneaking to cause harm.

ties.name: Elfin secret
ties.effect: One of six options — speak with birds, command plants, invisibility, enthral, divine desire, frighten mortals — with a Doom roll if used more than once per day.

ties.name: Silversmith sorcerer
ties.effect: Bind two rolled spells to jewelry, costing 1d6×100 coins and 3d6 days of work; the wearer casts them as a sorcerer.

ties.name: Skinwalker
ties.effect: Transform into an animal through a prepared pelt; own at most two pelts.

ties.name: True faith
ties.effect: Roll the Doom die to dispel one fey magical effect.

ties.name: Witchsight
ties.effect: See fey beings that are always visible; a WIS roll detects magical auras and illusions.

faerie_ties.binding: New ties form at the GM's discretion during play, with no formal mechanic.

marvels.name: Blood-tinted spyglass
marvels.effect: See living beings through obstacles and darkness.

marvels.name: Bomb
marvels.effect: d8 damage Nearby; a critical failure explodes near the user.

marvels.name: Firelance
marvels.effect: A ranged fire weapon adding Ud4 ongoing damage.

marvels.name: Freezing warhammer
marvels.effect: Freezes non-living matter; a rolled 20 deals d6 frost damage and destroys the target.

marvels.name: Hallucinogenic gas
marvels.effect: Indoors, roll d6 per person: 1–2 relaxed, 3–5 dreams, 6 panic.

marvels.name: Metal Owl
marvels.effect: An automaton following six-word orders; 4 HP; distracts only.

marvels.name: Prosthetic limb
marvels.effect: Functions as the original; sacrifice it to negate one attack.

marvels.name: Resurrection shot
marvels.effect: Roll d20 to avoid the Helpless table; a 20 means death.

marvels.name: Sleep box
marvels.effect: A music box trance; a Ud6 gives the duration in minutes.

marvels.name: Terror gas grenade
marvels.effect: Roll d6: 1–4 flee, 5–6 berserk with +d4 damage.

marvels.name: Truth serum
marvels.effect: The target speaks the truth; roll d20, and 15–20 means death before speaking.

twisted_science.building: Build marvels in a well-equipped workshop; invention points equal the INT score per week; a marvel's cost is its bracketed invention-point number.

runic_weapons.session_int_test: The GM makes an INT test for the weapon at the start of each session. On a success, the weapon kills its wielder if the wielder ever becomes helpless during that session.
runic_weapons.damage: The weapon inflicts damage equal to one of the wielder's attributes, fixed by the weapon's personality.

on_kill.note: Project-authored ordering. The SRD names six on-kill effects without numbering them; face 1 is the deterministic heal the engine applies, and faces 2 through 6 carry the five fictional effects for the narrator.

results.1: The weapon feeds the kill's vitality to the wielder, who regains d6 hit points.
results.2: The weapon devours the victim's soul, placing it beyond any resurrection.
results.3: The weapon absorbs the victim's memories and offers them to the wielder.
results.4: The victim's body transforms into an inert or grotesque form.
results.5: A tattoo marking the kill manifests on the wielder's skin.
results.6: The corpse converts to volatile matter and explodes.
